translations.literal: In the Renzong reign the Temple of Manifest Loyalty was built at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: In the Renzong reign the Temple of Manifest Loyalty was built at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 同治中興，湖南有表忠祠，湘鄉、平江有忠義祠，洞庭君山、湘鄉、桂陽有昭忠祠。

translations.literal: In the Tongzhi restoration, Hunan had the Temple of Commended Loyalty; Xiangxiang and Pingjiang had Temples of Loyalty and Righteousness; Dongting's Junshan, Xiangxiang, and Guiyang had Temples of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi restoration Hunan had the Temple of Commended Loyalty; Xiangxiang and Pingjiang had Temples of Loyalty and Righteousness; and Dongting's Junshan, Xiangxiang, and Guiyang had Temples of Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 他如湖口石鐘山水師，金陵湘軍陸師，楚軍水師，吳淞外海水師，台灣淮楚軍，蘇州、武昌、保定、廬州、巢湖、濟南、無錫各地淮軍，使凡轉戰糜軀者，莫不馨香血食，其為昭忠一也。

translations.literal: Elsewhere, the naval forces at Shizhong Mountain on Lake Poyang, the Hunan land forces at Jinling, the Chu naval forces, the outer-sea naval forces at Wusong, the Huai-Chu forces in Taiwan, and the Huai forces at Suzhou, Wuchang, Baoding, Luzhou, Chaohu, Jinan, Wuxi, and other places—all who died in battle received fragrant offerings of blood sacrifice; all alike were temples of manifest loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Elsewhere the naval forces at Shizhong Mountain on Lake Poyang, the Hunan land forces at Jinling, the Chu naval forces, the outer-sea naval forces at Wusong, the Huai-Chu forces in Taiwan, and Huai forces at Suzhou, Wuchang, Baoding, Luzhou, Chaohu, Jinan, Wuxi, and elsewhere—all who fell in battle received fragrant blood offerings; all were temples of manifest loyalty alike.

sentences.zh: 此外江寧、京口旗營，金陵軍營官紳，武昌武毅軍，成都嵩武軍，錦州毅軍，各昭忠祠，與各州縣忠義、昭忠、慰忠、忠烈等祠，所以䘏死酬勛，不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Besides these, temples of manifest loyalty for the Jiangning and Jingkou garrisons, Jinling military officials and gentry, the Wuyi Army at Wuchang, the Songwu Army at Chengdu, the Yi Army at Jinzhou, and Temples of Loyalty and Righteousness, Manifest Loyalty, Consoling Loyalty, and Loyal Martyrs in various prefectures and counties—all to comfort the dead and reward merit—are too numerous to record.
translations.idiomatic: Besides these were temples of manifest loyalty for the Jiangning and Jingkou garrisons, Jinling military officials and gentry, the Wuyi Army at Wuchang, the Songwu Army at Chengdu, the Yi Army at Jinzhou, and temples of loyalty, manifest loyalty, consoling loyalty, and loyal martyrs in counties and prefectures across the land—all to comfort the dead and reward merit—too numerous to record.

sentences.zh: 祭禮、祭品如前儀。

translations.literal: Sacrificial rites and offerings followed the preceding regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial rites and offerings followed the regulations described above.

sentences.zh: 宗室家廟崇德元年，定宗室封王者立家廟。

translations.literal: Ancestral Temples of the Imperial Clan. In the first year of Chongde it was established that princes of the imperial clan enfeoffed as kings should establish ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral Temples of the Imperial Clan. In the first year of Chongde it was established that enfeoffed princes of the imperial clan should establish ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，詔王無嗣，祔饗太廟後殿西廡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi an edict stated that when a prince had no heir, he should be enshrined in attendance in the western wing of the rear hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shunzhi an edict stated that when a prince died without heirs, he should be enshrined in the western wing of the rear hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 有子孫者，立廟別祭。

translations.literal: Those who had descendants established separate temples for distinct worship.
translations.idiomatic: Those who left descendants established separate temples for their own line.

sentences.zh: 四孟月、歲暮陪祭太廟，畢，歸府第行之。

translations.literal: In the four months of the first season and at year's end they accompanied the sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; when finished, the rites were performed at the princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the four first months of the seasons and at year's end they first accompanied the sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; when that was finished, the rites were performed at the princely residence.

sentences.zh: 凡薦新，未獻太廟者，不得私獻家廟。

translations.literal: For all offerings of new harvest, what had not yet been presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple could not be privately presented at the family temple.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings of new harvest could not be presented at the family temple until they had first been offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 於時庄親王立一廟，禮、巽、謙三親王合一廟，饒餘郡王、端重親王合一廟，穎親王、順承郡王合一廟，豫郡王一廟，克勤、衍禧二郡王合一廟。

translations.literal: At that time Prince Zhuang established one temple; Princes Li, Xun, and Qian shared one temple; the Prince of the Commandery of Raoyu and Prince Duanzhong shared one temple; Prince Ying and the Prince of the Commandery of Shuncheng shared one temple; the Prince of the Commandery of Yu had one temple; and the Princes of the Commanderies of Keqin and Yanxi shared one temple.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Prince Zhuang had one temple; Princes Li, Xun, and Qian shared one; the Prince of Raoyu and Prince Duanzhong shared one; Prince Ying and the Prince of Shuncheng shared one; the Prince of Yu had one; and the Princes of Keqin and Yanxi shared one.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，怡賢親王立一廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongzheng Prince Yixian established one temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Yongzheng Prince Yixian established one temple.

sentences.zh: 凡親王世子、郡王家祭，建廟七楹，中五為堂，左右牆隔之為夾室。

translations.literal: For the heir of a prince or the heir of a commandery prince performing family sacrifices, a temple of seven bays was built; the central five formed the hall, with side chambers partitioned by walls on left and right.
translations.idiomatic: For the heir of a prince or commandery prince performing family sacrifices, a temple of seven bays was built: the central five formed the hall, flanked by chambers partitioned by walls.

sentences.zh: 堂後楣北五室，中奉始封王，世世不祧。

translations.literal: Behind the hall, north of the crossbeam, were five chambers; the center enshrined the first enfeoffed prince, never removed from worship.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the hall, north of the lintel, were five chambers; the center held the first enfeoffed prince, never removed from worship.

sentences.zh: 高、曾、祖、禰依序為二昭二穆，昭東穆西，親盡則祧。

translations.literal: Great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father were arranged as two zhao and two mu; zhao to the east and mu to the west; when the line of descent was exhausted, tablets were removed.
translations.idiomatic: Great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father formed two zhao and two mu: zhao to the east, mu to the west; when the line of descent was exhausted, tablets were removed.

sentences.zh: 由昭祧者，藏主東夾室，升二昭位於一室，以二室奉升祔主。

translations.literal: Those removed from the zhao were stored in the eastern side chamber; the two zhao positions were elevated into one chamber to receive the ascending enshrined tablets.
translations.idiomatic: Tablets removed from the zhao were stored in the eastern side chamber; the two zhao positions were combined into one chamber to receive ascending enshrined tablets.

sentences.zh: 由穆祧者，藏西夾室，升祔亦如之。

translations.literal: Those removed from the mu were stored in the western side chamber; ascending enshrinement followed the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Tablets removed from the mu were stored in the western side chamber; ascending enshrinement followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 南為中門，又南廟門，左右側門，庭分東、西廡，東藏衣冠，西則祭器、樂器。

translations.literal: To the south was the central gate, and further south the temple gate, with side gates on left and right; the courtyard had eastern and western wings—the east storing robes and caps, the west storing sacrificial vessels and musical instruments.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood the central gate and beyond it the temple gate, with side gates on either side; the courtyard had eastern and western wings—the east for robes and caps, the west for sacrificial and musical instruments.

sentences.zh: 廟重檐，丹楹，采桷，綠瓦，紅堊壁。

translations.literal: The temple had double eaves, vermilion pillars, painted rafters, green tiles, and red plastered walls.
translations.idiomatic: The temple had double eaves, vermilion pillars, painted rafter ends, green tiles, and red plastered walls.

sentences.zh: 門內焚帛爐。

translations.literal: Inside the gate was a furnace for burning silk.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the gate stood a furnace for burning silk offerings.

sentences.zh: 外刲牲房，西鄉。

translations.literal: Outside was the slaughtering room, to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Outside, to the west, was the slaughtering room.

sentences.zh: 歲以四時仲月諏吉，仲春出祧主合食。

translations.literal: Each year on an auspicious day in the second month of the four seasons, in the second month of spring the removed tablets were brought out for a combined feast.
translations.idiomatic: Each year on an auspicious day in the second month of each season, in mid-spring the removed tablets were brought out for a combined offering.

sentences.zh: 其禮，堂中始封祖專案，正位，南鄉。

translations.literal: For the rites, in the hall the founding ancestor had a separate table at the central position, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: In the hall the founding ancestor had a separate table at the central position, facing south.

sentences.zh: 左東夾祧主共案，次二昭共案，東鄉。

translations.literal: To the left, the removed tablets of the eastern side chamber shared one table; next, the two zhao shared one table, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: To the left, removed tablets from the eastern side chamber shared one table; next, the two zhao shared one table, facing east.

sentences.zh: 右西夾室祧主共案，次二穆共案，西鄉。

translations.literal: To the right, the removed tablets of the western side chamber shared one table; next, the two mu shared one table, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: To the right, removed tablets from the western side chamber shared one table; next, the two mu shared one table, facing west.

sentences.zh: 少西設香帛案一，尊案一，每案羊、豕各一，鉶、簠、簋各二，籩、豆各八。

translations.literal: Further west one table for incense and silk and one table for libation vessels were set; on each table were one sheep and one pig, two sets each of meat dishes, grain vessels, and eight each of baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Further west stood one table for incense and silk and one for libation vessels; each bore one sheep and one pig, two sets each of meat dishes and grain vessels, and eight each of baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 位各帛一、爵三、樂器六。

translations.literal: At each position were one piece of silk, three libation cups, and six musical instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Each position had one piece of silk, three libation cups, and six musical instruments.

sentences.zh: 同祖所出子孫，成人以上，屆期會祭，府僚與陪，執事通贊、屬官為之。

translations.literal: Descendants of the same founding ancestor who had reached adulthood assembled for the sacrifice; household officials attended in support, with a master of ceremonies and subordinate officials serving.
translations.idiomatic: Adult descendants of the same founding ancestor assembled for the sacrifice; household officials attended, with a master of ceremonies and subordinate officials directing the rites.

sentences.zh: 奉香、帛、爵則用子孫。

translations.literal: Presenting incense, silk, and libation cups was performed by descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants presented the incense, silk, and libation cups.

sentences.zh: 先三日，主人齋外寢，眾咸齋。

translations.literal: Three days beforehand the host fasted and slept outside the main quarters; all others also fasted.
translations.idiomatic: Three days beforehand the host fasted and slept outside the main quarters; all participants fasted as well.

sentences.zh: 祀日昧爽，主人朝服入，位堂檐內正中，與祭伯叔輩位東階上，兄弟子孫位東階下，位以世差，世以齒序。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice, before dawn the host entered in court dress and took his place in the center beneath the hall eaves; paternal uncles of the same generation stood on the eastern steps above, brothers and descendants below, positions graded by generation and ordered by age.
translations.idiomatic: On the sacrifice day before dawn the host entered in court dress and stood in the center beneath the hall eaves; paternal uncles stood on the upper eastern steps, brothers and descendants on the lower, arranged by generation and age.

sentences.zh: 官屬位西階下，序以爵。

translations.literal: Officials stood on the western steps below, ordered by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officials stood on the lower western steps, ordered by rank.

sentences.zh: 俱北面。

translations.literal: All faced north.
translations.idiomatic: All faced north.

sentences.zh: 質明，子弟長者二人詣世祖室，四人分詣東西夾室，昭、穆室，各奉主安幾。

translations.literal: At daybreak two elder sons went to the founding ancestor's chamber; four others went separately to the eastern and western side chambers and the zhao and mu chambers, each bearing a tablet to place on the table.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak two senior descendants went to the founding ancestor's chamber; four others went to the eastern and western side chambers and the zhao and mu chambers, each bearing a tablet to place on its table.

sentences.zh: 昭，考右妣左；

translations.literal: For zhao, the father was placed to the right and the mother to the left;
translations.idiomatic: In the zhao positions, the father was placed to the right and the mother to the left;

sentences.zh: 穆，考左妣右。

translations.literal: for mu, the father was placed to the left and the mother to the right.
translations.idiomatic: in the mu positions, the father was placed to the left and the mother to the right.

sentences.zh: 跪，一叩，興。

translations.literal: They knelt and kowtowed once, then rose.
translations.idiomatic: They knelt and kowtowed once, then rose.

sentences.zh: 主人盥，就位，迎神樂作。

translations.literal: The host washed his hands and took his place; music sounded to welcome the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The host washed his hands and took his place as music sounded to welcome the spirits.

sentences.zh: 詣始祖位前三上香，以次詣各祧位前上香，率族屬行二跪六拜禮。

translations.literal: He offered incense three times before the founding ancestor, then incense before each removed tablet in turn, and led the clan in two kneelings and six kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: He offered incense three times before the founding ancestor, then before each removed tablet in turn, and led the clan in two kneelings and six kowtows.

sentences.zh: 奉帛、爵奠、獻、讀祝如儀。

translations.literal: Silk and libation cups were presented, offerings made, and the prayer read according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Silk and libation cups were presented, offerings made, and the prayer read according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 三獻訖，詣始祖位前跪受爵、受胙，三拜，徹饌，送神，二跪六拜。

translations.literal: When the three offerings were finished, he knelt before the founding ancestor to receive the libation cup and sacrificial meat, kowtowed three times, withdrew the offerings, sent off the spirits with two kneelings and six kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: When the three offerings were complete, he knelt before the founding ancestor to receive the libation cup and sacrificial meat, kowtowed three times, withdrew the offerings, and sent off the spirits with two kneelings and six kowtows.

sentences.zh: 詣燎位視燎。

translations.literal: He went to the burning place to oversee the burning of offerings.
translations.idiomatic: He went to the burning place to oversee the burning of offerings.

sentences.zh: 禮成，奉主還室，退。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, the tablets were returned to their chambers and all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, the tablets were returned to their chambers and all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 分胙頒族屬。

translations.literal: Sacrificial meat was distributed among the clan.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial meat was then distributed among the clan.

sentences.zh: 其時祭之禮，堂中設案五，始祖考、妣正位南鄉，高、曾、祖、禰，依昭穆為左右。

translations.literal: For sacrifices at that time, five tables were set in the hall; the founding ancestor's father and mother occupied the central position facing south; great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father were arranged left and right according to zhao and mu.
translations.idiomatic: For sacrifices at that time five tables were set in the hall: the founding ancestor's father and mother at the central position facing south, with great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father arranged to left and right according to zhao and mu.

sentences.zh: 案各羊一、豕一，餘如合食制。

translations.literal: Each table had one sheep and one pig; the remainder followed the combined feast regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Each table had one sheep and one pig; all else followed the combined feast regulations.

sentences.zh: 其時節薦新，屆日主人夙興，率子弟盛服入廟，潔堂宇，設案，陳果羞盤各六，每位箸二、盞三。

translations.literal: For seasonal offerings of new harvest at that time, on the appointed day the host rose early and led the sons and younger brothers in full dress into the temple, cleaned the hall, set tables, and laid out six trays each of fruit and delicacies, with two pairs of chopsticks and three cups at each position.
translations.idiomatic: For seasonal offerings of new harvest, on the appointed day the host rose early and led sons and younger brothers in full dress into the temple, cleaned the hall, set tables, and laid out six trays each of fruit and delicacies, with two pairs of chopsticks and three cups at each position.

sentences.zh: 啟室，以次詣各案前跪上香，三拜，子弟遍獻酒，主人二跪六拜，子弟隨行禮。

translations.literal: The chambers were opened; in turn they knelt before each table and offered incense, kowtowed three times; the sons and younger brothers presented wine throughout; the host knelt twice and kowtowed six times, and the sons and younger brothers followed in the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The chambers were opened; they knelt before each table in turn and offered incense, kowtowing three times; sons and younger brothers presented wine throughout; the host knelt twice and kowtowed six times, with the sons and younger brothers following.

sentences.zh: 畢，闔室，退。

translations.literal: When finished, the chambers were closed and all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, the chambers were closed and all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 因事致告，薦果羞各四，禮同薦新。

translations.literal: When reporting affairs, four trays each of fruit and delicacies were offered; the rites were the same as for offerings of new harvest.
translations.idiomatic: When reporting affairs, four trays each of fruit and delicacies were offered, following the same rites as for new harvest offerings.

sentences.zh: 月朔望謁廟亦如之。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of the month, visiting the temple followed the same practice.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month, visiting the temple followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 貝勒、貝子、宗室公家祭廟五楹，三為堂。

translations.literal: For the family sacrifices of beile, beizi, and imperial clan dukes, the temple had five bays, three forming the hall.
translations.idiomatic: For family sacrifices of beile, beizi, and imperial clan dukes, the temple had five bays, three forming the hall.

sentences.zh: 後楣北分室五，奉始封祖暨四代。

translations.literal: North of the rear crossbeam five chambers were divided, enshrining the first enfeoffed ancestor and four generations.
translations.idiomatic: North of the rear crossbeam were five divided chambers enshrining the first enfeoffed ancestor and four generations.

sentences.zh: 兩旁夾室奉親盡祧主。

translations.literal: The side chambers on either side enshrined tablets removed when the line of descent was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Side chambers on either side held tablets removed when the line of descent was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 廟不重檐，門不備采，餘如親王。

translations.literal: The temple had no double eaves and the gates had no painted brackets; otherwise it followed the prince's model.
translations.idiomatic: The temple had no double eaves and the gates lacked painted brackets; otherwise it followed the princely model.

sentences.zh: 合食，始祖專案，羊一、豕一，東夾室祧主暨二昭專案，羊豕各一。

translations.literal: For the combined feast the founding ancestor had a separate table with one sheep and one pig; the eastern side chamber's removed tablets and two zhao had a separate table with one sheep and one pig each.
translations.idiomatic: For the combined feast the founding ancestor had a separate table with one sheep and one pig; the eastern side chamber's removed tablets and two zhao shared a table with one sheep and one pig.

sentences.zh: 西夾室祧主暨二穆亦如之。

translations.literal: The western side chamber's removed tablets and two mu were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The western side chamber's removed tablets and two mu were arranged the same way.

sentences.zh: 時祭俱專案，昭穆各同牲，籩、豆視親王各減二，不用樂，一跪三拜。

translations.literal: Seasonal sacrifices each had separate tables; zhao and mu shared the same sacrificial animals; baskets and stands were each two fewer than for princes; music was not used; one kneeling and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal sacrifices used separate tables; zhao and mu shared sacrificial animals; baskets and stands were each two fewer than for princes; no music was used; one kneeling and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 時節薦果盤各四，有事則告，朔望則謁。

translations.literal: At seasonal festivals four trays of fruit were offered; when there was business to report, offerings were made; on the first and fifteenth the temple was visited.
translations.idiomatic: At seasonal festivals four trays of fruit were offered; affairs were reported when needed; on the first and fifteenth the temple was visited.

sentences.zh: 餘如親王儀。

translations.literal: The remainder followed the princely ritual.
translations.idiomatic: All else followed the princely ritual.

sentences.zh: 品官士庶家祭凡品官家祭廟立居室東，一至三品廟五楹，三為堂，左右各一牆限之。

translations.literal: Family Sacrifices of Officials, Gentry, and Commoners. For all officials, the family sacrifice temple was established east of the main residence; for ranks one through three the temple had five bays, three forming the hall, with a wall on either side as partition.
translations.idiomatic: Family Sacrifices of Officials, Gentry, and Commoners. Officials established family temples east of the main residence; ranks one through three built temples of five bays, three forming the hall, partitioned by walls on either side.

sentences.zh: 北為夾室，南為房。

translations.literal: To the north were side chambers; to the south were rooms.
translations.idiomatic: To the north were side chambers; to the south were rooms.

sentences.zh: 庭兩廡，東藏衣物，西藏祭器。

translations.literal: In the courtyard were eastern and western wings—the east storing clothing, the west storing sacrificial vessels.
translations.idiomatic: The courtyard had eastern and western wings—the east for clothing, the west for sacrificial vessels.

sentences.zh: 庭繚以垣。

translations.literal: The courtyard was enclosed by a wall.
translations.idiomatic: The courtyard was enclosed by a wall.

sentences.zh: 四至七品廟三楹，中為堂，左右夾室及房，有廡。

translations.literal: For ranks four through seven the temple had three bays, the center serving as the hall, with side chambers and rooms on left and right and wings in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: For ranks four through seven the temple had three bays with the center as hall, side chambers and rooms on either side, and courtyard wings.

sentences.zh: 八、九品廟三楹，中廣，左右狹，庭無廡。

translations.literal: For ranks eight and nine the temple had three bays, wide in the center and narrow on the sides, with no wings in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: For ranks eight and nine the temple had three bays, wide in the center and narrow at the sides, with no courtyard wings.

sentences.zh: 篋藏衣物、祭器，陳東西序。

translations.literal: Chests stored clothing and sacrificial vessels, arranged in eastern and western rows.
translations.idiomatic: Chests held clothing and sacrificial vessels, arranged in eastern and western rows.

sentences.zh: 堂後四室，奉高、曾、祖，禰，左昭、右穆。

translations.literal: Behind the hall were four chambers enshrining great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father, with zhao to the left and mu to the right.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the hall were four chambers for great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father, zhao to the left and mu to the right.

sentences.zh: 妣以嫡配，南鄉。

translations.literal: Consorts were paired with the legitimate wife, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts were paired with the legitimate wife, all facing south.

sentences.zh: 高祖以上，親盡則祧。

translations.literal: For ancestors above the great-great-grandfather, when the line of descent was exhausted tablets were removed.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors above the great-great-grandfather were removed when the line of descent was exhausted.

sentences.zh: 由昭祧者，藏主東夾室；

translations.literal: Those removed from the zhao were stored in the eastern side chamber;
translations.idiomatic: Those removed from the zhao were stored in the eastern side chamber;

sentences.zh: 由穆祧者，藏主西夾室。

translations.literal: those removed from the mu were stored in the western side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: those removed from the mu were stored in the western side chamber.

sentences.zh: 遷室、祔廟，並依昭穆世次，東西序為祔位，伯叔祖父兄弟子姓成人無後者、殤者，以版按行輩墨書，男東女西，東西鄉。

translations.literal: Moving chambers and enshrining in the temple all followed zhao-mu order by generation; eastern and western rows served as positions for enshrined attendance; paternal uncles, grandfathers, brothers, sons, and adult male kin without heirs, and those who died young, were recorded on tablets arranged by generation in ink—males to the east and females to the west, facing east and west respectively.
translations.idiomatic: Moving chambers and enshrining in the temple followed zhao-mu order by generation; eastern and western rows held enshrined attendance; uncles, grandfathers, brothers, sons, and adult male kin without heirs, and those who died young, were recorded on tablets by generation in ink—males east, females west.

sentences.zh: 定牲器之數，一至三品，羊一、豕一，每案俎二，鉶、登各二，籩、豆各六。

translations.literal: The number of sacrificial animals and vessels was fixed: for ranks one through three, one sheep and one pig per table, two meat stands per table, two each of meat dishes and grain vessels, and six each of baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial animals and vessels were fixed by rank: ranks one through three had one sheep and one pig per table, two meat stands, two each of meat dishes and grain vessels, and six each of baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 四至七品，特豕，案一俎，籩、豆各四。

translations.literal: For ranks four through seven, a pig alone was used; one meat stand per table; four each of baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks four through seven used a pig alone, one meat stand per table, and four each of baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 八品以下，豚肩不特殺，案一俎，籩、豆各二。

translations.literal: For rank eight and below, a pork shoulder without special slaughter; one meat stand per table; two each of baskets and stands.
translations.idiomatic: Rank eight and below used a pork shoulder without special slaughter, one meat stand per table, and two each of baskets and stands.

sentences.zh: 歲祭以四時仲月諏吉，讀祝、贊禮、執爵皆子弟為之。

translations.literal: Annual sacrifices were held on auspicious days in the second month of the four seasons; reading the prayer, assisting in the rites, and presenting libation cups were all performed by sons and younger brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Annual sacrifices were held on auspicious days in the second month of each season; reading the prayer, assisting in the rites, and presenting libation cups were performed by sons and younger brothers.

sentences.zh: 子孫年及冠，皆會祭。

translations.literal: All descendants who had reached adulthood assembled for the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: All descendants who had come of age assembled for the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 前三日，主人暨在事者齋。

translations.literal: Three days beforehand the host and those involved fasted.
translations.idiomatic: Three days beforehand the host and all participants fasted.

sentences.zh: 祀日五鼓，主人朝服，眾盛服，入廟。

translations.literal: On the sacrifice day at the fifth watch the host wore court dress and all wore formal attire and entered the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the sacrifice day at the fifth watch the host wore court dress, all wore formal attire, and entered the temple.

sentences.zh: 主人俟東階下，族姓俟庭東西，順昭穆世次。

translations.literal: The host waited below the eastern steps; clan members waited east and west in the courtyard, ordered by zhao-mu generation.
translations.idiomatic: The host waited below the eastern steps; clan members waited in the courtyard east and west, ordered by zhao-mu generation.

sentences.zh: 主婦率諸婦盛服入，詣爨所視烹飪。

translations.literal: The hostess led the women in formal attire into the kitchen to oversee the cooking.
translations.idiomatic: The hostess led the women in formal attire to the kitchen to oversee the cooking.

sentences.zh: 羹定，入東房治籩、豆，陳鉶、登、匕、箸、醯、醬以俟。

translations.literal: When the soup was ready, they entered the eastern room to prepare baskets and stands, arranging meat dishes, grain vessels, spoons, chopsticks, vinegar, and sauce in readiness.
translations.idiomatic: When the soup was ready, they entered the eastern room to prepare baskets and stands and arrange meat dishes, grain vessels, spoons, chopsticks, vinegar, and sauce.

sentences.zh: 質明，子弟長者啟室，奉主陳之幾，昭位考右妣左，分薦者設東西祔位。

translations.literal: At daybreak the senior sons opened the chambers, bore the tablets to place on the tables—with the father to the right and mother to the left at zhao positions; those enshrined in attendance had tables set in eastern and western rows.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak senior sons opened the chambers and placed the tablets on the tables—at zhao positions the father to the right and mother to the left; enshrined attendance had tables in eastern and western rows.

sentences.zh: 主人升自東階，盥訖，詣中檐拜位立。

translations.literal: The host ascended by the eastern steps; after washing his hands he stood at the bowing position in the center beneath the eaves.
translations.idiomatic: The host ascended the eastern steps; after washing his hands he stood at the bowing position beneath the central eaves.

sentences.zh: 族姓行尊者立兩階上，卑者立階下。

translations.literal: Senior clan members stood on both stairways above; junior members stood below.
translations.idiomatic: Senior clan members stood on the upper steps; junior members below.

sentences.zh: 咸北面。

translations.literal: All faced north.
translations.idiomatic: All faced north.

sentences.zh: 主人詣香案前跪，三上香，進奠爵，興，復位，率族姓一跪三拜。

translations.literal: The host knelt before the incense table, offered incense three times, presented the libation cup, rose, returned to his place, and led the clan in one kneeling and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: The host knelt before the incense table, offered incense three times, presented the libation cup, rose, returned to his place, and led the clan in one kneeling and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 主人詣高祖案前獻爵，曾、祖、禰案前畢獻如儀，分薦者遍獻祔位酒，讀祝。

translations.literal: The host presented the libation cup before the great-great-grandfather's table; at the great-grandfather's, grandfather's, and father's tables he presented in the same manner; those enshrined in attendance presented wine at all positions; the prayer was read.
translations.idiomatic: The host presented the libation cup at the great-great-grandfather's table, then at the great-grandfather's, grandfather's, and father's tables in the same manner; enshrined attendance received wine at all positions; the prayer was read.

sentences.zh: 每獻，主婦率諸婦致薦，一叩興。

translations.literal: At each presentation the hostess led the women in offering; one kowtow and rise.
translations.idiomatic: At each presentation the hostess led the women in offering, with one kowtow and rise.

sentences.zh: 初獻匕箸醯醬，亞獻羹飯肉胾，三獻餅餌果蔬。

translations.literal: At the first presentation spoons, chopsticks, vinegar, and sauce; at the second soup, rice, meat, and sliced meat; at the third cakes, pastries, and fruit.
translations.idiomatic: The first presentation brought spoons, chopsticks, vinegar, and sauce; the second soup, rice, meat, and sliced meat; the third cakes, pastries, and fruit.

sentences.zh: 卒獻，主人跪香案前，祝代祖考致嘏於主人，主人啐酒嘗食，反器於祝，一叩興，復位，送神，一跪三拜。

translations.literal: At the final presentation the host knelt before the incense table; the prayer reader spoke blessings from the ancestors to the host on their behalf; the host sipped wine and tasted the food, returned the vessels to the prayer reader, kowtowed once and rose, returned to his place, sent off the spirits with one kneeling and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: At the final presentation the host knelt before the incense table; the prayer reader conveyed the ancestors' blessings to the host; the host sipped wine and tasted the food, returned the vessels to the prayer reader, kowtowed once and rose, then sent off the spirits with one kneeling and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 視燎畢，與祭者出，主人率子弟納神主，上香行禮。

translations.literal: When the burning was finished, those who had sacrificed withdrew; the host led the sons and younger brothers to return the spirit tablets, offered incense, and performed the rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the burning was finished the participants withdrew; the host led sons and younger brothers to return the spirit tablets, offered incense, and performed the closing rites.

sentences.zh: 徹祭器，闔門，退。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels were removed, the doors closed, and all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels were removed, the doors closed, and all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 日中而餕。

translations.literal: The feast was held at midday.
translations.idiomatic: The communal feast was held at midday.

sentences.zh: 三品以上，時祭遍舉。

translations.literal: For rank three and above, seasonal sacrifices were held at all four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of rank three and above held seasonal sacrifices in all four seasons.

sentences.zh: 四至七品，春、秋二舉。

translations.literal: For ranks four through seven, sacrifices were held in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of ranks four through seven held sacrifices in spring and autumn only.

sentences.zh: 八九品春一舉。

translations.literal: For ranks eight and nine, one sacrifice in spring.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of ranks eight and nine held one sacrifice in spring.

sentences.zh: 與祭者，尊卑咸在。

translations.literal: All who had sacrificed, high and low, were present.
translations.idiomatic: All participants, high and low, were present.

sentences.zh: 主人肅入席，酌尊者酒，子弟年長者離席酌主人，長幼獻酬交錯。

translations.literal: The host entered the feast with reverence; he poured wine for the honored elders; elder sons and younger brothers left their seats to pour for the host; the young and old offered and returned wine in turn.
translations.idiomatic: The host took his seat with reverence and poured wine for honored elders; elder sons and younger brothers left their seats to pour for the host; young and old exchanged toasts in turn.

sentences.zh: 已事，咸出。

translations.literal: When the business was finished, all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 徹席，餕庖人、僕人必盡之。

translations.literal: When the feast was cleared, the cooks and servants must consume everything.
translations.idiomatic: When the feast was cleared, cooks and servants were to consume everything remaining.

sentences.zh: 令節薦新，一至三品，每案果、羞各四，四至七品，減果二，八、九品並減羞二，具羹飯則同。

translations.literal: For festival offerings of new harvest, ranks one through three had four trays each of fruit and delicacies at every table; ranks four through seven reduced fruit by two; ranks eight and nine reduced delicacies by two as well; when soup and rice were provided the rules were the same.
translations.idiomatic: For festival offerings of new harvest, ranks one through three had four trays each of fruit and delicacies per table; ranks four through seven reduced fruit by two; ranks eight and nine reduced delicacies by two; soup and rice followed the same rules.

sentences.zh: 月朔望供茶，食案二器，儀同時薦。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of the month tea was offered, with two vessels on the food table; the rites followed seasonal offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month tea was offered with two vessels on the food table, following seasonal offering rites.

sentences.zh: 庶士家祭，設龕寢堂北，以版隔為四室，奉高、曾、祖、禰，妣配之，位如品官儀，南鄉。

translations.literal: For the family sacrifices of common gentry, a shrine niche was set on the north side of the main hall, partitioned by boards into four chambers enshrining great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father, with consorts paired; positions followed the official model, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Common gentry established a shrine niche on the north side of the main hall, partitioned into four chambers for great-great-grandfather through father, with consorts paired, all facing south as for officials.

sentences.zh: 服親成人無後者，順行輩書紙為祔位，已事，焚之，不立版。

translations.literal: Adult male kin without heirs were recorded on paper as enshrined attendance by generation; after the rites the paper was burned and no tablet was kept.
translations.idiomatic: Adult male kin without heirs were honored on paper tablets by generation; after the rites the paper was burned and no permanent tablet kept.

sentences.zh: 每四時節日，出主以薦，粢盛二盤，肉食果蔬四器，羹二，飯二。

translations.literal: At each of the four seasonal festivals the tablets were brought out for offering: two trays of grain, four vessels of meat, fruit, and vegetables, two soups, and two bowls of rice.
translations.idiomatic: At each seasonal festival the tablets were brought out: two trays of grain, four vessels of meat and vegetables, two soups, and two bowls of rice.

sentences.zh: 先期致齋。

translations.literal: Fasting was observed beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Fasting was observed beforehand.

sentences.zh: 薦之前夕，主婦在房治饌，逮明，主人吉服，率子弟奉主陳香案，昭東穆西，設祔位西序案，主人立東階下，眾按行東西立。

translations.literal: On the evening before the offering the hostess prepared food in her room; at dawn the host in auspicious dress led the sons and younger brothers to bear the tablets to the incense table—zhao to the east and mu to the west—with enshrined attendance at a table in the western row; the host stood below the eastern steps and all stood east and west by generation.
translations.idiomatic: On the evening before, the hostess prepared food; at dawn the host in auspicious dress led sons and younger brothers to place the tablets at the incense table—zhao east, mu west—with enshrined attendance at a western table; the host stood below the eastern steps, all arranged by generation.

sentences.zh: 主人上香畢，一跪三拜，興。

translations.literal: When the host had finished offering incense, one kneeling and three kowtows, then rose.
translations.idiomatic: The host offered incense, knelt once and kowtowed three times, then rose.

sentences.zh: 主婦率諸婦出房薦匕箸醯醬，跪，叩，退。

translations.literal: The hostess led the women out to offer spoons, chopsticks, vinegar, and sauce; they knelt, kowtowed, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The hostess led the women to offer spoons, chopsticks, vinegar, and sauce; they knelt, kowtowed, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 主人至案前，以次酌酒、薦熟，跪，叩，興。

translations.literal: The host went before the table and in turn poured wine and offered cooked food; knelt, kowtowed, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The host went to the table, poured wine and offered cooked food in turn, knelt, kowtowed, and rose.

sentences.zh: 子弟薦祔位，畢，讀祭文。

translations.literal: Sons and younger brothers offered at enshrined attendance positions; when finished, the sacrificial text was read.
translations.idiomatic: Sons and younger brothers offered at enshrined attendance positions; when finished, the sacrificial text was read.

sentences.zh: 再獻，主婦薦飯羹，三獻薦餅餌時蔬。

translations.literal: At the second presentation the hostess offered rice and soup; at the third, cakes and seasonal vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: At the second presentation the hostess offered rice and soup; at the third, cakes and seasonal vegetables.

sentences.zh: 主人率族姓行禮訖，焚祭文及祭位，納主，徹退，日中而餕。

translations.literal: When the host had led the clan through the rites, the sacrificial text and paper enshrinement positions were burned, the tablets returned, vessels removed, and all withdrew; the feast was held at midday.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, the sacrificial text and paper positions were burned, the tablets returned, and all withdrew; the feast was held at midday.

sentences.zh: 春一舉，月朔望獻茶，有事則告，俱一跪三拜。

translations.literal: One offering in spring; on the first and fifteenth tea was offered; when there was business to report, offerings were made—all with one kneeling and three kowtows.
translations.idiomatic: One offering in spring; tea on the first and fifteenth; affairs reported when needed—all with one kneeling and three kowtows.

sentences.zh: 庶人家祭，設龕正寢北，奉高、曾、祖、禰位，逢節薦新，案不逾四器，羹飯具。

translations.literal: For the family sacrifices of common households, a shrine was set on the north side of the main bedchamber enshrining great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father; at festivals new harvest was offered, with no more than four vessels on the table, soup and rice provided.
translations.idiomatic: Common households set a shrine on the north side of the main bedchamber for four generations; at festivals new harvest was offered with no more than four vessels on the table, together with soup and rice.

sentences.zh: 其日夙興，主婦治饌，主人率子弟安主獻祭，一切禮如庶士而稍約。

translations.literal: On that day they rose early; the hostess prepared food; the host led the sons and younger brothers to install the tablets and offer sacrifice—all rites like those of common gentry but somewhat simplified.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day they rose early; the hostess prepared food; the host led sons and younger brothers to install the tablets and sacrifice—all rites like common gentry but somewhat simpler.

sentences.zh: 月朔望供茶，燃香、鐙行禮。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth tea was offered; incense and lamps were lit and the rites performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth tea was offered, incense and lamps lit, and the rites performed.

sentences.zh: 告事亦如之。

translations.literal: Reporting affairs was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Reporting affairs followed the same practice.
